text:
Rae Summers: Quick heads-up — noticed a short spike where ~30 leads stayed unassigned for 3-8m. looks like the RR queue had microjams.
Tom Becker: saw that too. different pattern than the usual bulk import. possibly enrichment retries + small jitter in RR scheduler.
Linh Vu: can we add a tiny probe that emits hashed lead id + three timestamps (recv, enrich_done, assigned) + path and fallback flag? lightweight and sampled.
Asha Rao: yes. fields: lead_hash (salted), connector, recv_ts, enrich_done_ts, assign_ts, assign_path (rr|fallback|manual), fallback_reason, sla_tier, weekday_or_weekend.
Tom Becker: add `jitter_applied` boolean and `rr_host` (owner shard) so we can see skew per-host.
Rae Summers: include `first_touch_ts` when SDR touches it. that's the true handoff. also `backfill_attempted` flag if we try to replay assignment.
AssignBot: webhook received portal=204 at 1761112230 (evt hb_204_aa)
Linh Vu: sampling: start 5% global, 25% on internal tenants. retention: raw probes 7d, aggregated metrics 90d. opt-out via metadata.probe=false.
Asha Rao: compliance ok as long as lead_hash is salted and no direct PII. add consent_flag and tenant_region.
Tom Becker: sketch event (one-liner):
```
{"lead_hash":"sha256:abcd...","connector":"hubspot","recv_ts":1761112200,"enrich_done_ts":1761112230,"assign_ts":1761112250,"assign_path":"rr","jitter_applied":true}
```
Rae Summers: where do we route it? propose topic `inbound.handoff.probes` -> small consumer -> metrics exporter -> Console card under Inbound Routing -> Handoff Sankey (we want a Sankey view).
Linh Vu: Sankey would be awesome — show flows: recv -> enrich -> assign (rr/fallback/manual) -> first_touch. helps visualize drop-offs.
Tom Becker: I'll build the consumer and a Prom exporter. will emit: assign_latency histogram, fallback_rate gauge, rr_skew metric per-host.
Asha Rao: alerts: p95 assign latency > 180s -> page oncall. fallback_rate > 1.5% sustained 10m -> ops alert. rr_skew > 3x expected -> notify infra.
Rae Summers: rollout plan: internal full sample 48h -> 5% prod 72h -> 30% 7d -> aggregate-only. canary auto-disable if canary p95 > 4m.
Linh Vu: also add a conserved privacy rule: drop events for tenants with less than 1 lead/min to avoid deanonymization.
AssignBot: bulk import job 333 completed size=9200 at 1761112300
Tom Becker: good to know. will correlate batch size -> backlog depth. add `connector_batch_id` in event.
Asha Rao: tasks: Tom -> consumer + tests (hashing + salt), Linh -> dashboard ticket and Sankey mock, Rae -> customer-facing note for Sales/CS.
Linh Vu: creating ticket MKT-7111 "Handoff Sankey + jitter/replay probe" and assigning @Tom and @Rae.
Rae Summers: pro tip: add `replay_reason` and `replay_outcome` to track whether backfills fixed fairness issues. opt-in per-tenant.
Tom Becker: will add that. PR target Thu EOD, staging run Fri, prod canary Mon.
Linh Vu: I'll include demo screenshots in the ticket. Rae, please draft the one-pager for customers explaining what the Sankey shows and how to interpret fallback rates.
Asha Rao: legal to review PR once ready. ensure sampling respects trials vs paid.
AssignBot: connector webhook backlog: 1 pending retry for portal=204
Rae Summers: thanks team. reconvene after staging run to set final SLOs and decide if automatic replay should be enabled by default. :rocket:
